title: Gate logs get a JSON summary beside them
what: Store a JSON summary (head, exit, failed tests, duration) beside each gate log and let the merge check read that, not the first and last line of the log text (lib/relay_marks.py:170-181; the gate writes those two lines itself in lib/relay_gate.py:99).
why: The structured-data rule: what a later step reads is a structured file. Today the two lines are written by the gate itself, so this is a cleanup of the format, not a defect.
